name: Cambridge Depersonalisation Scale (CDS)
sourceInstrument: Cambridge Depersonalisation Scale (Sierra & Berrios, 2000; user-supplied text)
directions: For each experience, rate how often it occurred over the last six months and its average duration. If unsure, give your best estimate.
interpretationNote: Frequency and duration ratings are recorded separately. Do not treat their combined raw sum as a validated total: the supplied material does not define the item-level multiplication/scoring procedure. No diagnostic cutoff is applied.
